items.name: Polish Championship 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjI2NTAxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--632b6a3ab2ed161932853b127f8aa4b538046c5e/pss%20logo%20male.png) ![](https://i.imgur.com/y4aZ08M.png) Mistrzostwa Polski w Speedcubingu to najważniejsza impreza sezonu w kalendarzu każdego polskiego speedcubera. Od 2005 roku nieprzerwanie przyciąga najlepszych zawodników, którzy w atmosferze ducha fair play walczą o tytuł mistrza kraju we wszystkich oficjalnych konkurencjach ![](https://i.imgur.com/i1ldA95.png) Polish Championships is the most important competition in calendar of any Polish speedcuber. Since 2005 it brings best competitors who fight for Polish Champion titles in all official events in fair play atmosphere. ### **The organization team kindly asks international competitors NOT to register for the Polish Speedcubing Championship 2026 in Gdańsk.** In our view, a national championship should be reserved for the citizens of that country. This is just one of around 100 competitions held in Poland this year – you are more than welcome to attend any of the others.

items.information: # This is a weeknight competiton! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSBNovemberWeekday2026#82246-competitor-responsibilities) tab. ​ Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. ​ This competition is organized by UCSB Cube Club, in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/). ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjI1MzI0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d1a192a6c214fddfb59b8965cbc2b44c15459a41/WCC%20Orange.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI3Nzk4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7fcfe0ac63464a9b1a80e5381178937d257b9d63/UCSB_Club_Comp_Page.png) ### UCSB Students If you are a UCSB Student or Faculty member, your registration fee for this competition will be waived. Register for the competition without paying, and contact the [organization team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=UCSBNovemberWeekday2026&contactRecipient=competition) with your credentials (such as a student ID) attached. Your registration will be accepted in the order in which this email is received.

items.name: Venezuela Nationals 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE4OTk1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3512594a5886b2ba3e691701e88553273742e493/Venezuela%20Nationals%202026.png) ## ![Español](https://i.ibb.co/R9FXtCV/spanish-flag.png) Español ## Bienvenido al Venezuela Nationals 2026 ### El Campeonato tiene dos sedes, por favor lee la pestaña de [Ubicación](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2026#81373-ubicacion-location) **Por favor leer todas las pestañas antes de registrarte, hay mucha información importante que debes saber, incluso si eres un competidor recurrente.** * Límite de **100 competidores** para el registro. * Es una competencia abierta, para competidores de cualquier edad y experiencia. * **Nuevos Competidores:** hemos creado una [pestaña exclusiva](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2026#81375-nuevos-competidores-newcomers) para ustedes. Muy importante leerla. * Si tiene dudas, contactar al equipo organizador. #### 📸 Aviso de Filmación Al asistir a **Venezuela Nationals 2026**, autorizas a la organización a tomar fotografías y grabar videos durante el evento. Estas imágenes podrán ser utilizadas para la promoción futura de competencias, redes sociales y sitio web oficial, transmisiones en vivo, así como para material documental y archivo histórico. Si no deseas aparecer en ninguna grabación, por favor notifícalo al equipo organizador al momento de tu registro o durante el evento. Tu participación implica la aceptación de este aviso. ## ![English](https://i.ibb.co/HT0yLMw/english-flag.png) English ## Welcome to Venezuela Nationals 2026 ### The Championship has two venues, please check the [Location] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2026#81373-ubicacion-location) tab **Please read all the tabs before registering; there is a lot of important information you should know, even if you are a recurring competitor.** * Competitor registration limit: **100**. * It is an open competition, for competitors of any age and experience. * **New Competitors:** we have created an [exclusive tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VenezuelaNationals2026#81376-) for you. It is very important to read it. * If you have any questions, contact the organizing team. #### 📸 Filming Notice By attending **Venezuela Nationals 2026**, you authorize the organization to take photographs and record videos during the event. These images may be used for future competition promotion, social media and official website, live streaming, as well as for documentary and historical archive material. If you do not wish to appear in any recording, please notify the organizing team at the time of registration or during the event. Your participation implies acceptance of this notice. ## **Información de Contacto / Contact Info:** • Enrymar Cisneros Teléfono: 0426-5335576 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584265335576&text=%C2%A1Hola!%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20obtener%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20de%20la%20competencia%20*Venezuela%20Nationals%202026*) speedcubingvenezuela@gmail.com • Rafael Antonio Sánchez: Teléfono: 0412-8571331 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584128571331&text=%C2%A1Hola!%20Me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20obtener%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20de%20la%20competencia%20*Venezuela%20Nationals%202026*) rafaelmachele@gmail.com
